# SROTrac — India's self-regulatory organisations, tracked

> Independent register of India's self-regulatory organisations across four regulators: RBI (FACE, UFF, FIDC, SRPA, MFIN, Sa-Dhan, FEDAI, Sahamati, FIMMDA), SEBI (BASL for investment advisers/research analysts, AIBI for investment bankers; AMFI and ANMI tracked as unrecognised context), IRDAI (Life Insurance Council, General Insurance Council — statutory councils under the Insurance Act 1938 s.64C), and IBBI (the three insolvency professional agencies: IIIPI of ICAI, ICSI IIP, IPA of ICMAI). Tracks member rosters, governance, activity and enforcement gaps from a consumer-protection lens. Run by CashlessConsumer. Scope: recognised and statutory SROs of RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and IBBI (18 entries; AMFI and ANMI flagged as unrecognised context). Data CC BY 4.0.

Base URL: https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in

## Register
- [FACE](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-face.html): Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment — RBI recognition 2024-08-28; 85 listed members.
- [UFF](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-uff.html): Unified Fintech Forum — RBI recognition 2026-09-10; 121 listed members.
- [FIDC](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-fidc.html): Finance Industry Development Council — RBI recognition 2025-10-03; no published roster.
- [SRPA](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-srpa.html): Self-Regulated PSO Association — RBI recognition 2025-11-11; 18 listed members.
- [MFIN](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-mfin.html): Microfinance Institutions Network — RBI recognition 2014-06-16; 84 listed members.
- [Sa-Dhan](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-sadhan.html): Sa-Dhan (Association of Community Development Finance Institutions) — RBI recognition 2015-03-11; no published roster.
- [FEDAI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-fedai.html): Foreign Exchange Dealers' Association of India — RBI recognition 2026-01-14; 108 listed members.
- [Sahamati](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-sahamati.html): Sahamati — RBI recognition 2026-06-05; 110 listed members.
- [FIMMDA](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-fimmda.html): Fixed Income Money Market and Derivatives Association of India — RBI recognition 2025-05-07; 116 listed members.
- [BASL](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-basl.html): BSE Administration and Supervision Ltd — RBI recognition 2021-06-01; no published roster.
- [AIBI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-aibi.html): Association of Investment Bankers of India — RBI recognition 1997-98 (AR); no published roster.
- [LI Council](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-lic.html): Life Insurance Council — RBI recognition 1938 (s.64C); no published roster.
- [GI Council](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-gic.html): General Insurance Council — RBI recognition 1938 (s.64C); no published roster.
- [IIIPI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-iiipi.html): Indian Institute of Insolvency Professionals of ICAI — RBI recognition 2016-17; no published roster.
- [ICSI IIP](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-icsiip.html): ICSI Institute of Insolvency Professionals — RBI recognition 2016-17; no published roster.
- [IPA ICMAI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-ipaicmai.html): Insolvency Professional Agency of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India — RBI recognition 2016-17; no published roster.
- [AMFI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-amfi.html): Association of Mutual Funds in India — RBI recognition — (association, 1995); 56 listed members.
- [ANMI](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/sro-anmi.html): Association of National Exchanges Members of India — RBI recognition — (association, 1996); no published roster.

## Deep dives (what each SRO actually does)
- [FACE work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-face.html): Standards, oversight & dispute resolution for digital lending
- [UFF work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-uff.html): Digital lending's second SRO-FT: born as DLAI, recognised 10 Sep 2026
- [FIDC work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-fidc.html): NBFCs' SRO: the most active consultation respondent
- [SRPA work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-srpa.html): Payment aggregators' young SRO: founded by practitioners, one year old
- [MFIN work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-mfin.html): The original SRO experiment: NBFC-MFIs since 16 June 2014
- [Sa-Dhan work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-sadhan.html): Community-development finance's SRO: standards since 2015
- [FEDAI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-fedai.html): Authorised dealers' rulebook: 30 years of forex standards
- [Sahamati work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-sahamati.html): Standards body of the account-aggregator ecosystem — now its RBI-recognised SRO
- [FIMMDA work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-fimmda.html): The bond market's own rulebook: valuations, market practices and standard agreements
- [BASL work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-basl.html): Administration and supervision of investment advisers and research analysts (SEBI)
- [AIBI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-aibi.html): SEBI-recognised standards body for investment (merchant) bankers
- [LI Council work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-lic.html): Statutory self-regulatory council for life insurance (Insurance Act s.64C, IRDAI)
- [GI Council work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-gic.html): Statutory self-regulatory council for general and health insurance (Insurance Act s.64C, IRDAI)
- [IIIPI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-iiipi.html): First registered insolvency professional agency — ICAI (IBBI/IPA/16-17/01)
- [ICSI IIP work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-icsiip.html): Insolvency professional agency of ICSI (IBBI/IPA/16-17/02)
- [IPA ICMAI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-ipaicmai.html): Insolvency professional agency of ICMAI (IBBI/IPA/16-17/03)
- [AMFI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-amfi.html): Mutual funds' association — self-regulatory in practice, not by recognition (SEBI context entry)
- [ANMI work](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/work-anmi.html): Stock brokers' pan-India association — campaigning for SRO status (SEBI context entry)

## Cross-cutting pages
- [All members](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/members.html): searchable 642-row roster with per-SRO filters.
- [Members](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/members.html): filterable register of all listed entities; includes the cross-SRO overlap matrix and 2+ SRO memberships.
- [Timeline](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/timeline.html): 2020–2026 regulatory milestones (frameworks, recognitions, consultations).
- [Activity](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/activity.html): dated log of SRO/RBI developments with sources.
- [Social](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/social.html): official X/LinkedIn/YouTube/Facebook/Instagram accounts of the nine RBI-recognised SROs (register covers RBI SROs at present), with a daily drift check against their own websites.
- [About & methodology](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/about.html): scope, method, caveats, FAQ.
- [Blog](https://srotrac.cashlessconsumer.in/blog/index.html): weekly summaries.
